task.text:
[0] Autors do not provide values for the mean life span, the p-values only are available. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, worms were transferred in the 20 µg/ml FUDR containing media.

[1] CASP2 knockout caused lifespan decrease and early onset of aging phenotypes in mice.

[2] Transgenic mice that overexpress human catalase localized to the peroxisome, the nucleus, or mitochondria (MCAT) were generated. Median and maximum life spans were maximally increased in MCAT animals (fig 3C, founders 4403). Min and max values were found on the graph. Max LP was measured using combined data (17%, 4.5months p=0,001)

[3] Transgenic mice that overexpress human catalase localized to the peroxisome, the nucleus, or mitochondria (MCAT) were generated. Median and maximum life spans were maximally increased in MCAT animals (fig 3C, founders 4033). Min and max values were found on the graph. Max LP was measured using combined data (17%, 4.5 months p=0,001).

[4] Transgenic mice that overexpress human catalase localized to the peroxisome, the nucleus, or mitochondria (MCAT) were generated. Median and maximum life spans were maximally increased in MCAT animals (fig S2). Min and max lifespan was found on the graph. Significant increase in lifespan was found p<0.0001 for males and p=0.0003 for females with MCAT.

[5] Transgenic mice that overexpress human catalase localized to the peroxisome, the nucleus, or mitochondria (MCAT) were generated. Median and maximum life spans were maximally increased in MCAT animals (fig S2). Min and max lifespan was found on the graph. Significant increase in lifespan was found p<0.0001 for males and p=0.0003 for females with MCAT.

[6] Survival of transgenic animals and littermate pairs was analyzed for CAT expressed in peroxisomes (PCAT). Figure 2A, founders 2058.

[7] Survival of transgenic animals and littermate pairs was analyzed for CAT expressed in peroxisomes (PCAT). Figure 2A, founders 2088, p=0,02

[8] Survival of transgenic animals and littermate pairs was analyzed for CAT expressed in the nucleus (NCAT). Figure 2В, founders 885

[9] Survival of transgenic animals and littermate pairs was analyzed for CAT expressed in the nucleus (NCAT). Figure 2В, founders 900

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
